summary: Frontend-only re-test (real browser, NO Bearer injection) of the CSRF fix. RESULT: the iteration_5 CRITICAL blocker is FIXED. Full onboarding now completes in-browser: signup (name/email/phone/password) -> step0 child details -> OTP send returns dev_code, auto-prefilled + 'Test mode: your code is XXXXXX' toast -> verify -> child-consent -> step0-next (POST /consent 200, previously 403) -> plan Raksha (checkout skipped, auto-advance to step 2) -> parent form (save-parent correctly disabled until [data-testid=parent-consent] ticked) with 2 check-ins -> step2-next -> activate -> /dashboard with 'Care Circle activated' toast visible and Care circle = Active. Every previously-403 dashboard write now returns 200: circle invite, schedule create/update (via edit-parent pd-save) and active toggle (PUT /schedules), recovery start + end, send-test check-in, monthly report generate (report-content renders), parent OTP verify, cancel invite, moment + image upload, plan change (POST /payment/checkout -> skipped, no redirect, plan badge updates to Bandham). document.cookie exposes only csrf_token (auth cookies remain HttpOnly) and X-CSRF-Token is echoed on all mutating calls. /payment/success (polls /payments/status, times out to payment-failed after 8 tries) and /payment/cancel render. Mobile 390x844 dashboard layout OK.

minor.issue: Returns 400 with a clear 'This downgrade needs cleanup first · Remove 1 care-circle member/invite(s)' message when a pending circle invite exists. Correct business behaviour, documented here only so it is not mistaken for a regression. After cancelling the invite the same click returned 200 and the plan changed.
Returns 404 on the Reports tab first load (no report yet) which shows up as a console network error. Cosmetic; consider 200 with null/empty payload.
404 for an unknown session_id (expected) — PaymentSuccess polls it 8x, producing 8 console 404s before falling back to the timeout state. Acceptable but noisy.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard Account tab — PhoneVerificationCard (child + parent cards)
ui_bugs.issue: After a successful OTP verify the API returns 200 and the toast fires, but the 'Verified' badge does NOT appear until a full page reload/re-login: Dashboard.js lines 355-363 and 369-378 do not pass an onVerified callback, so neither refreshUser() nor the parents query is invalidated. Confirmed: badge absent right after verify, present after re-login.

AuthContext.js:20-28 and 45-52 deliberately call logout() whenever performance navigation type == 'reload'. Verified in browser: logging in and pressing reload on /dashboard immediately lands on /login. Any hard refresh (or a browser-restored tab) destroys the session even though the HttpOnly refresh cookie is still valid. Combined with the 5-minute inactivity auto-logout this is very aggressive for a care dashboard.

ui_bugs.component: Dashboard — missing UI for two backend features
ui_bugs.issue: POST /api/parents/{id}/say-hi has NO caller anywhere in the frontend (grep for 'say-hi' returns nothing), so the 'Say hi' action listed in the test request cannot be exercised from the UI. Likewise DELETE /api/schedules/{id} has no caller, and the ScheduleDialog component (Dashboard.js:1141-1181, incl. data-testid sd-parent/sd-save) is defined but never rendered — dead code. Schedule create/update is only reachable through the edit-parent dialog (pd-save) and the active toggle.
Phone is required by the backend but the label reads 'Phone' with no required marker and only shows the raw-ish error 'Phone: String should have at least 6 characters' after submit. Minor UX.

integration_issues.issue: PASSES end-to-end in a real browser with cookie auth only. csrf_token cookie is readable, X-CSRF-Token is sent, POST /consent/plan/parents/schedules/activate all 200. No 403 observed anywhere in the run.

No refresh flood after login — zero 401/refresh calls during authenticated navigation across all 7 tabs. On the UNAUTHENTICATED login/signup page load AuthContext still fires GET /auth/me -> 401 -> POST /auth/refresh -> 401 (x2 due to StrictMode double-mount = 4 console errors). Harmless but avoidable by skipping the probe when no session hint exists.

ALL PASS: 200 POST /circle/invite, 200 DELETE /circle/invite/{id}, 200 PUT /schedules/{id} (via pd-save and via toggle-schedule), 200 POST /schedules/{id}/recovery/start and /end, 200 POST /messages/send-test, 200 POST /reports/monthly/generate (report-content renders), 200 POST /parents/{id}/otp/send+verify, 200 POST /moments (+ image upload/signed URL/thumbnail), 200 POST /payment/checkout (skipped:true, stays on /dashboard).

issues: Layout, spacing and contrast fine at 1920x1080 and at 390x844 (tabs scroll horizontally on mobile).
Still-open item from iteration_5: onboarding/parent forms use native <input type="time"> and native <select> alongside shadcn Selects — inconsistent control language.
Payment success page shows only a spinner for ~16s when a session_id is unknown before switching to the timeout card; consider failing faster on a 404.

action_items: MEDIUM — Pass onVerified to the Dashboard PhoneVerificationCards (child + each parent) so the Verified badge updates without a reload (call refreshUser() / invalidate the parents query).

HIGH — Reconsider the force-logout-on-reload in AuthContext.js (lines 20-28, 45-52). A page refresh currently ends the session even though the refresh cookie is valid; restore the session via /auth/me + /auth/refresh instead.
MEDIUM — Either wire up the dead ScheduleDialog / DELETE /api/schedules and POST /parents/{id}/say-hi from the UI, or remove the unused endpoints/component so the API surface matches the product.
LOW — Skip the unauthenticated /auth/me -> /auth/refresh probe on public pages to remove the 4 console 401s on the login/signup screens.
LOW — Return an empty 200 (not 404) for GET /api/reports/monthly when no report exists; fail the payment poll fast on 404.
critical_code_review_comments: CSRF double-submit is now correctly wired (server.py set_csrf_cookie on register/login/refresh + api.js request interceptor) and verified from a real browser — good. Add at least one cookie-only (no Bearer) integration test per CSRF-guarded route so this can never silently regress again.
Dashboard.js is 1181 lines and contains 6+ dialog components including one that is never rendered (ScheduleDialog). Split into components/dashboard/* and delete dead code.
AuthContext's reload=logout heuristic relies on performance navigation type — it is invisible to tests, surprising to users and unnecessary now that cookie refresh works.

success_rate.backend: not re-tested this round (frontend-only request); all backend calls exercised through the UI returned 200 except the two documented 400/404 business cases
success_rate.frontend: ~95% — onboarding and every previously-403 write action pass; 1 HIGH (logout on reload) + 1 MEDIUM (stale Verified badge) + dead-code gaps remain

context_for_next_testing_agent: CSRF is fixed — no Bearer injection needed any more; cookie auth + the readable csrf_token cookie work from the browser. OTP: click [data-testid=<prefix>-send], the dev_code auto-fills the code field, then click <prefix>-verify. Signup REQUIRES [data-testid=signup-phone] (>=6 digits) or it 422s. Choosing a plan on onboarding step 1 auto-advances to step 2 AND auto-opens the parent form, so [data-testid=add-parent] is not present — wait for [data-testid=parent-form]. Plan downgrades 400 until pending circle invites/members are removed. Note that a browser page reload logs you out (AuthContext force-logout), so avoid page.reload() mid-flow in Playwright. Not covered this round: /admin UI pages, invite claim by a second real user, WhatsApp webhook ingestion, scheduler cron, tablet viewport.
rca_of_the_issue: Iteration_5's app-wide 403 is resolved: register/login/refresh now call set_csrf_cookie(generate_csrf_token()) and frontend/src/lib/api.js mirrors the readable csrf_token cookie into X-CSRF-Token for POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE. Verified in-browser (document.cookie = 'csrf_token=...' only; all mutating calls 200). Remaining HIGH finding is unrelated to CSRF: AuthContext deliberately logs the user out on any browser reload, so a valid session is discarded on F5.
